name: didban-javascript-sdk
description: Didban JavaScript SDK monorepo for browser, React Native, Node.js, and NestJS applications.

scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run --workspace @didban/core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @didban/browser-sdk && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @didban/react-native && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @didban/node-sdk && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @didban/nestjs
